## What

Adds `TraceLens_loom_port_cfg`: loads a Hugging Face checkpoint through the same AST backend as `TraceLens_visualize_model_in_explorer`/`TraceLens_model_roofline_projection`, and derives the subset of [`loom-port-llm`](https://github.com/loom-fun/loom-skills/tree/main/skills/loom-port-llm)'s `cfg.json` architecture fields that follow directly from the checkpoint's own `config.json`/modeling source: `hidden`/`layers`/`heads`/`kv_heads`/`head_dim`/`ffn`/`vocab`/`context_length`/`tied_embeddings`, `rms_eps`, `rope_theta`/`rope_dims`, `qk_norm`, `sliding_layers`/`sliding_window`, `recurrent_layers`.

## Why this scope

A runnable Loom model needs hand-authored `.loom` kernel/control/prepare programs (e.g. `hrx-loom-library`'s `Qwen3.8-27B` card wires ~150 hand-written kernel files) — TraceLens's AST backend only has analytical FLOPs/bytes formulas, with no notion of GPU kernel bodies or quantization packing, so it can't author those.

The real opening is `loom-port-llm`'s config-driven generator (`starter/gen_llm.py`), which turns a declarative `cfg.json` into actual kernels for the dense-transformer family. That `cfg.json` comes from the skill's own `inspect_gguf.py`, which reverse-engineers GGUF tensor names and either hardcodes or leaves several fields blank (`rope_type`, `embed_scale`, `sliding_layers`, `nope_layers`) for a human to fix by reading `llama.cpp`'s `src/models/<arch>.cpp`. `TraceLens.ModelUtils.extract.ArchitectureSpec` already parses the checkpoint's real config/source (ground truth, no GGUF round-trip) and already carries most of this, so this PR is a thin, honestly-scoped mapping from that spec to the `cfg.json` fields TraceLens can state with confidence — plus a `--check` mode that diffs against an already-authored `cfg.json`.

`--tp`/`--pp`/`--ep` and the roofline CLI's `--batch-size`/`--seq-len`/`--gpu-arch-name` do not apply: `loom-serve` runs a model whole on one device, and `cfg.json` is a static architecture description, not a workload projection.

**Deliberately left alone** (documented, never guessed): `rope_type` (a `llama.cpp` GGUF weight-permutation convention, not an HF-source property), `attn_gate`/`post_norms`/`embed_scale`/`embed_norm` (need AST submodule/weight-name inspection this repo doesn't do yet), `gdn` kernel geometry, `tensors`/`gguf`/`chat`/`eos_id`/`bos_id` (GGUF conversion and Jinja-chat-template concerns, owned by `inspect_gguf.py`/`chat_probe.py`).

## Changes

- `TraceLens/ModelUtils/loom_port_cfg.py`: `build_loom_arch_facts`, `coverage_notes`, `diff_against_existing`.
- `TraceLens/ModelUtils/loom_port_cfg_cli.py` + `setup.py` console_scripts entry: `TraceLens_loom_port_cfg`, reusing `add_model_source_arguments`/`add_runtime_regime_arguments` from `cli_common.py`.
- `tests/ModelUtils/test_loom_port_cfg.py`: 26 tests (unit coverage for every derived field + CLI smoke tests).
- `docs/how-to/generate-loom-port-config.md` + `docs/index.rst` toctree entry.

## Testing

`black --check`, `python tests/update_copyright.py` (no unrelated files touched), and `pytest tests/ModelUtils/test_loom_port_cfg.py tests/ModelUtils/test_extract_edges.py tests/ModelUtils/test_loader.py tests/Visualizer/test_roofline_projection.py` — 149 passed.

@@ -0,0 +1,235 @@
+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Architecture facts for Loom's ``loom-port-llm`` ``cfg.json``, from an ``ArchitectureSpec``.
+
+``loom-port-llm`` (https://github.com/loom-fun/loom-skills/tree/main/skills/loom-port-llm)
+turns a declarative ``cfg.json`` into Loom IR kernels for the dense-transformer
+family (``starter/gen_llm.py``). Today that ``cfg.json`` comes from
+``inspect_gguf.py``, which reverse-engineers GGUF tensor names and either
+hardcodes or leaves blank several fields (``rope_type``, ``embed_scale``,
+``sliding_layers``, ``nope_layers``, ...) that its own "cfg.json review
+checklist" tells a human to fix by reading ``llama.cpp``'s
+``src/models/<arch>.cpp``.
+
+:class:`TraceLens.ModelUtils.extract.ArchitectureSpec` already parses the
+checkpoint's real ``config.json`` and modeling source -- ground truth, no GGUF
+round-trip -- so this module derives the subset of ``cfg.json`` architecture
+fields that can be read from it with confidence, and leaves the rest alone
+rather than guessing: ``rope_type`` is a ``llama.cpp`` GGUF weight-permutation
+convention, not a property of the HF source; ``attn_gate``/``post_norms``/
+``embed_scale``/``embed_norm`` need submodule/weight-name AST inspection
+``extract.py`` doesn't do today; ``tensors``/``gguf``/``chat``/``eos_id``/
+``bos_id`` stay owned by ``inspect_gguf.py`` / ``chat_probe.py``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.extract import ArchitectureSpec
+
+# Constants
+
+# HF's own near-universal default when a RoPE model's config omits an
+# explicit theta (every HF RoPE config class defaults to this).
+_DEFAULT_ROPE_THETA = 10000.0
+
+# config.json ``layer_types`` entries that name ordinary (full or windowed)
+# attention; anything else (``linear_attention``, ``gated_delta_net``, ...)
+# is treated as a non-attention (recurrent) layer kind.
+_ATTENTION_LAYER_TYPES = frozenset({"full_attention", "sliding_attention"})
+
+
+def build_loom_arch_facts(
+    spec: ArchitectureSpec, *, name: str | None = None
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Map *spec* to the ``cfg.json`` architecture fields TraceLens can derive.
+
+    ``name`` should be the checkpoint id/path as the caller passed it
+    (``spec.checkpoint_source`` is a resolved ``config.json`` URI/path, e.g.
+    ``hf://org/repo/config.json``, not the clean display name ``cfg.json``
+    wants); falls back to ``spec.name`` when omitted.
+
+    Core geometry fields (``hidden``, ``layers``, ``heads``, ``kv_heads``,
+    ``head_dim``, ``ffn``, ``vocab``, ``context_length``, ``tied_embeddings``)
+    are always present (``None`` when the checkpoint's config never declared
+    one). Everything else is included only when derived with confidence; a
+    field this module cannot derive is simply absent, never guessed.
+    """
+    config = spec.raw_config
+    heads = spec.num_attention_heads
+    kv_heads = spec.num_key_value_heads or heads
+    head_dim = spec.head_dim
+    if head_dim is None and spec.hidden_size and heads:
+        head_dim = spec.hidden_size // heads
+
+    facts: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "name": name or spec.name,
+        "arch": spec.model_type,
+        "hidden": spec.hidden_size,
+        "layers": spec.num_hidden_layers,
+        "heads": heads,
+        "kv_heads": kv_heads,
+        "head_dim": head_dim,
+        "ffn": spec.intermediate_size,
+        "vocab": spec.vocab_size,
+        "context_length": spec.max_position_embeddings,
+        "tied_embeddings": spec.tie_word_embeddings,
+    }
+
+    rms_eps = _cfg(config, "rms_norm_eps", "layer_norm_eps")
+    if rms_eps is not None:
+        facts["rms_eps"] = rms_eps
+
+    if spec.positional_encoding == "RoPE":
+        facts["rope_theta"] = _cfg(config, "rope_theta") or _DEFAULT_ROPE_THETA
+        rope_dims = _rope_dims(config, head_dim)
+        if rope_dims is not None:
+            facts["rope_dims"] = rope_dims
+
+    qk_norm = _as_bool(_cfg(config, "qk_norm", "use_qk_norm"))
+    if qk_norm is not None:
+        facts["qk_norm"] = qk_norm
+
+    sliding_layers, sliding_window = _sliding_layers(config, spec.num_hidden_layers)
+    if sliding_layers is not None:
+        facts["sliding_layers"] = sliding_layers
+        facts["sliding_window"] = sliding_window
+
+    recurrent_layers = _recurrent_layers(config)
+    if recurrent_layers is not None:
+        facts["recurrent_layers"] = recurrent_layers
+
+    return facts
+
+
+def coverage_notes(spec: ArchitectureSpec) -> list[str]:
+    """Free-text caveats: HF architecture names, and families the starter kit (or
+    this module) doesn't cover, for a human to act on rather than silently drop.
+    """
+    notes: list[str] = []
+    if spec.architectures:
+        notes.append(
+            f"HF architectures: {spec.architectures} -- resolve against the "
+            "GGUF 'arch' string by hand if it doesn't already match."
+        )
+    if spec.attention_type == "MLA":
+        notes.append(
+            "Multi-head Latent Attention: the starter kit's attention kernels "
+            "assume standard (GQA/MHA) KV; see 'Beyond the starter' in loom-port-llm."
+        )
+    if spec.decoder_type == "Sparse MoE":
+        notes.append(
+            "Sparse MoE: the starter kit covers dense FFN only; see the MoE "
+            "pattern under 'Beyond the starter' in loom-port-llm."
+        )
+    if _recurrent_layers(spec.raw_config) is not None:
+        notes.append(
+            "recurrent_layers inferred from config.layer_types values outside "
+            "{full_attention, sliding_attention} -- verify against gen_gdn.py's "
+            "expected geometry and fill cfg.json's gdn block by hand."
+        )
+    if _cfg(spec.raw_config, "no_rope_layers") is not None:
+        notes.append(
+            "config declares 'no_rope_layers'; not auto-translated to nope_layers "
+            "here -- verify its 0/1 polarity against the model's own source and "
+            "fill cfg.json's nope_layers by hand."
+        )
+    return notes
+
+
+def diff_against_existing(
+    derived: dict[str, Any], existing: dict[str, Any]
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Compare *derived* facts against an already-authored ``cfg.json``.
+
+    Reports a mismatch for every key *derived* states that disagrees with
+    *existing*, and an addition for every key *derived* states that
+    *existing* lacks. Fields this module never derives are not in *derived*
+    and so are never flagged.
+    """
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    for key, value in derived.items():
+        if key not in existing:
+            lines.append(f"{key}: derived {value!r}, missing from existing cfg.json")
+            continue
+        existing_value = existing[key]
+        if _normalize(value) != _normalize(existing_value):
+            lines.append(f"{key}: derived {value!r} != existing {existing_value!r}")
+    return lines
+
+
+def _cfg(config: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
+    """First present, non-null value among *keys* in a raw HF config dict."""
+    for key in keys:
+        if key in config and config[key] is not None:
+            return config[key]
+    return None
+
+
+def _as_bool(value: Any) -> bool | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return bool(value)
+
+
+def _normalize(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return sorted(value, key=repr)
+    return value
+
+
+def _rope_dims(config: dict[str, Any], head_dim: int | None) -> int | None:
+    """Partial rotary embedding width, when the config states a fraction < 1."""
+    factor = _cfg(config, "partial_rotary_factor")
+    if not factor or not head_dim:
+        return None
+    rope_dims = round(float(factor) * head_dim)
+    return rope_dims if rope_dims != head_dim else None
+
+
+def _sliding_layers(
+    config: dict[str, Any], num_layers: int | None
+) -> tuple[list[int] | None, int | None]:
+    """Per-layer sliding-window layer indices, and the window size.
+
+    Prefers an explicit per-layer ``layer_types`` list (so an empty result
+    here means "no layer slides", not "unknown"); falls back to the
+    Qwen2/Qwen3-style ``use_sliding_window``/``max_window_layers`` pair.
+    """
+    layer_types = _cfg(config, "layer_types")
+    if isinstance(layer_types, list) and layer_types:
+        kinds = {str(kind) for kind in layer_types}
+        if kinds & _ATTENTION_LAYER_TYPES:
+            indices = [
+                i
+                for i, kind in enumerate(layer_types)
+                if str(kind) == "sliding_attention"
+            ]
+            return indices, _cfg(config, "sliding_window")
+
+    if _as_bool(_cfg(config, "use_sliding_window")):
+        max_window_layers = _cfg(config, "max_window_layers")
+        if max_window_layers is not None and num_layers:
+            return list(range(int(max_window_layers))), _cfg(config, "sliding_window")
+
+    return None, None
+
+
+def _recurrent_layers(config: dict[str, Any]) -> list[int] | None:
+    """Layer indices whose ``layer_types`` entry names neither full nor sliding
+    attention (a gated-delta-net/linear-attention/Mamba-style hybrid layer).
+    """
+    layer_types = _cfg(config, "layer_types")
+    if not isinstance(layer_types, list) or not layer_types:
+        return None
+    indices = [
+        i
+        for i, kind in enumerate(layer_types)
+        if str(kind) not in _ATTENTION_LAYER_TYPES
+    ]
+    return indices or None

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""CLI for a Loom ``loom-port-llm`` ``cfg.json`` architecture-facts export.
+
+Loads a checkpoint through the same AST backend as the Model Explorer export
+and the roofline projection (``TraceLens.ModelUtils`` loader), and derives the
+subset of ``loom-port-llm``'s ``cfg.json`` architecture fields TraceLens can
+read from the checkpoint's own ``config.json``/modeling source -- no GGUF
+conversion, chat-template, or kernel-tensor-format work attempted. See
+``TraceLens.ModelUtils.loom_port_cfg`` for exactly which fields and why.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.cli_common import (
+    add_model_source_arguments,
+    add_runtime_regime_arguments,
+    load_architecture_spec_from_args,
+)
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.loader import resolve_checkpoint_arg
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.loom_port_cfg import (
+    build_loom_arch_facts,
+    coverage_notes,
+    diff_against_existing,
+)
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="TraceLens_loom_port_cfg",
+        description=(
+            "Derive the architecture-fact fields of a Loom loom-port-llm cfg.json "
+            "(hidden/layers/heads/kv_heads/head_dim/ffn/vocab/context_length, "
+            "rms_eps, rope_theta/rope_dims, qk_norm, sliding_layers/sliding_window, "
+            "recurrent_layers) from a Hugging Face checkpoint's own config.json and "
+            "modeling source, with no GGUF conversion required. loom-serve runs a "
+            "model on one device, so there are no --tp/--pp/--ep flags here; "
+            "quantized tensor formats, the GGUF path, and the chat-template-derived "
+            "block stay owned by loom-port-llm's own inspect_gguf.py/chat_probe.py."
+        ),
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "source",
+        nargs="?",
+        help="Hugging Face model id or local checkpoint directory (alias for --checkpoint)",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--checkpoint",
+        "-c",
+        help="Hugging Face model id or local checkpoint path for config.json",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--title",
+        help="Architecture display name override",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--output",
+        "-o",
+        type=Path,
+        metavar="PATH",
+        help="Write the derived facts as JSON (default: stdout)",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        type=Path,
+        metavar="EXISTING_CFG.json",
+        help=(
+            "Diff the derived facts against an already-authored cfg.json (e.g. "
+            "one produced by loom-port-llm's inspect_gguf.py) and print mismatches "
+            "instead of writing --output."
+        ),
+    )
+    add_model_source_arguments(parser)
+    add_runtime_regime_arguments(parser)
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = build_parser()
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    checkpoint = resolve_checkpoint_arg(checkpoint=args.checkpoint, source=args.source)
+    if checkpoint is None and args.github is None:
+        parser.error(
+            "Provide a Hugging Face checkpoint (SOURCE or --checkpoint) and/or --github"
+        )
+
+    try:
+        spec = load_architecture_spec_from_args(
+            checkpoint, args, title=args.title, stop_at_roofline_ops=True
+        )
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        print(f"Error loading architecture: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(
+        spec, name=args.title or (str(checkpoint) if checkpoint else None)
+    )
+    for note in coverage_notes(spec):
+        print(f"Note: {note}", file=sys.stderr)
+
+    if args.check is not None:
+        try:
+            existing = json.loads(args.check.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+            print(f"Error reading {args.check}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+        mismatches = diff_against_existing(facts, existing)
+        if not mismatches:
+            print(f"No mismatches against {args.check}.")
+            return 0
+        print(f"Mismatches against {args.check}:")
+        for line in mismatches:
+            print(f"  {line}")
+        return 1
+
+    text = json.dumps(facts, indent=2)
+    if args.output is not None:
+        args.output.write_text(text + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        print(f"Wrote Loom architecture facts: {args.output}")
+    else:
+        print(text)
+
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+<!--

+
+# Derive a Loom port's cfg.json architecture facts from a checkpoint
+
+```{meta}
+:description: Derive the architecture-fact fields of a Loom loom-port-llm cfg.json from a Hugging Face checkpoint's own config.json and modeling source, with no GGUF conversion.
+:keywords: TraceLens, Loom, loom-port-llm, GGUF, cfg.json, RoPE, GQA, sliding window, static analysis, no trace, ROCm

+

+instead of executing any model code), and derives the subset of
+[`loom-port-llm`](https://github.com/loom-fun/loom-skills/tree/main/skills/loom-port-llm)'s
+`cfg.json` architecture fields that follow directly from the checkpoint's own
+`config.json` and modeling source — no GGUF conversion required.
+
+## Why this exists
+
+`loom-port-llm`'s `starter/gen_llm.py` turns a declarative `cfg.json` into
+Loom IR kernels for the dense-transformer family (Llama/Qwen2/Qwen3/Mistral-
+style). That `cfg.json` normally comes from the skill's own `inspect_gguf.py`,
+which reverse-engineers GGUF tensor names and metadata and either hardcodes or
+leaves blank several fields that its own "cfg.json review checklist" tells a
+human to fix by reading `llama.cpp`'s `src/models/<arch>.cpp` — `rope_type` is
+guessed from the architecture name, `qk_norm`/`attn_gate`/`post_norms` are
+guessed from GGUF tensor-name presence, and `sliding_layers`/`nope_layers` are
+always emitted empty.
+
+`TraceLens.ModelUtils.extract.ArchitectureSpec` already parses the
+checkpoint's real `config.json` and modeling source — ground truth, not a
+GGUF round-trip — so several of these follow directly from the checkpoint
+itself. This tool is a thin mapping from that spec to the `cfg.json` fields it
+can state with confidence, plus a `--check` mode that diffs against an
+already-authored `cfg.json` to flag mismatches.
+
+## Before you begin
+
+Confirm you have the following before continuing.
+
+- [TraceLens installed](../install/install.md).
+- A Hugging Face model id or local checkpoint directory with a `config.json`
+  and `modeling_*.py` (see `--github` below for checkpoints that don't ship
+  their own modeling source).
+
+## Run the tool
+
+```bash
+TraceLens_loom_port_cfg meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B
+```
+
+This prints the derived facts as JSON to stdout, and any coverage notes (MoE,
+MLA, or an unrecognized hybrid layer mix the starter kit doesn't cover) to
+stderr. Write it to a file with `--output`:
+
+```bash
+TraceLens_loom_port_cfg Qwen/Qwen3-8B --output cfg.json
+```
+
+## Checking an already-authored cfg.json
+
+`--check` diffs the derived facts against an existing `cfg.json` (for example
+one produced by `loom-port-llm`'s `inspect_gguf.py`) instead of writing one,
+automating part of its "cfg.json review checklist":
+
+```bash
+TraceLens_loom_port_cfg Qwen/Qwen3-8B --check ./cfg.json
+```
+
+Exits `0` with "No mismatches" when every field this tool derives agrees with
+the existing file, or prints each disagreement and exits `1` otherwise. A
+field this tool never derives is never flagged — `--check` only cross-checks
+what TraceLens can independently confirm.
+
+## Field coverage
+
+Always present (`null` when the checkpoint's own config never declared one):
+`hidden`, `layers`, `heads`, `kv_heads`, `head_dim`, `ffn`, `vocab`,
+`context_length`, `tied_embeddings`, `name`, `arch`.
+
+Present when the config states it: `rms_eps`, `rope_theta` (defaulted to
+`10000.0` when RoPE applies but no explicit theta is stated), `rope_dims`
+(from `partial_rotary_factor`), `qk_norm`, `sliding_layers`/`sliding_window`
+(an explicit per-layer list from `config.layer_types`, or the
+`max_window_layers` convention), `recurrent_layers` (layer indices whose
+`layer_types` entry names neither full nor sliding attention — a
+gated-delta-net/linear-attention/Mamba-style hybrid layer).
+
+**Deliberately not derived** — left to `inspect_gguf.py` / manual review,
+and never guessed:
+
+- `rope_type` (neox vs. norm rotary pairing) is a `llama.cpp` GGUF
+  weight-**permutation** convention introduced by the GGUF conversion step,
+  not a property of the HF modeling source.
+- `attn_gate`, `post_norms`, `embed_scale`, `embed_norm` need
+  submodule/weight-name AST inspection this tool doesn't do yet.
+- `nope_layers`: when the config states `no_rope_layers`, a note flags it for
+  manual translation rather than guessing its `0`/`1` polarity.
+- `gdn` kernel geometry (conv kernel size, head counts) beyond which layers
+  are recurrent.
+- `tensors` (quantized format/shape per weight), the `gguf` path, and the
+  Jinja-chat-template-derived `chat` block / `eos_id`/`bos_id` — these come
+  from the GGUF conversion and tokenizer, not the HF modeling source.
+
+## No `--tp`/`--pp`/`--ep`, no GPU-arch/batch/seq-len flags
+
+`loom-serve` runs a model whole on one device — nothing in `loom-port-llm`
+shards a model across GPUs — so `cfg.json`'s fields describe the model's full
+per-layer geometry and this tool has no partition flags. It is also a static
+architecture description, not a workload projection, so the roofline CLI's
+`--batch-size`/`--seq-len`/`--gpu-arch-name` don't apply either.
+
+## Model source and runtime regime flags
+
+The checkpoint-provenance flags (`--github`, `--config-path`, `--code-path`,
+`--basic-op-add`/`--basic-op-remove`, `--meta-shapes`/`--no-meta-shapes`) and
+the runtime-regime flags (`--phase`, `--cache`, `--sequence-layout`,
+`--attention`, `--mode`, `--device`, `--config-override`) are the same ones
+`TraceLens_visualize_model_in_explorer`/`TraceLens_model_roofline_projection`
+support, since all three tools build the checkpoint's architecture through the
+same backend — run `TraceLens_loom_port_cfg --help` for the full list.
+
+## Related topics
+
+- [Project a model's roofline from its checkpoint](./generate-model-roofline-projection.md)
+- [Model op performance without a trace](./perf-model-without-trace.md)
+- [API reference](../reference/api-reference.md)

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Tests for the Loom loom-port-llm cfg.json architecture-facts module and CLI."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.extract import parse_architecture
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.loom_port_cfg import (
+    build_loom_arch_facts,
+    coverage_notes,
+    diff_against_existing,
+)
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils import loom_port_cfg_cli
+
+FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "fixtures"
+
+_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG = {
+    "model_type": "llama",
+    "architectures": ["LlamaForCausalLM"],
+    "hidden_size": 2048,
+    "num_hidden_layers": 16,
+    "num_attention_heads": 32,
+    "num_key_value_heads": 8,
+    "intermediate_size": 8192,
+    "vocab_size": 128256,
+    "max_position_embeddings": 131072,
+    "rms_norm_eps": 1e-05,
+    "rope_theta": 500000.0,
+    "tie_word_embeddings": False,
+}
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# build_loom_arch_facts: core geometry
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+
+
+def test_dense_gqa_model_derives_core_geometry_and_rope():
+    spec = parse_architecture(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec, name="meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B")
+
+    assert facts["name"] == "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B"
+    assert facts["arch"] == "llama"
+    assert facts["hidden"] == 2048
+    assert facts["layers"] == 16
+    assert facts["heads"] == 32
+    assert facts["kv_heads"] == 8
+    assert facts["head_dim"] == 2048 // 32
+    assert facts["ffn"] == 8192
+    assert facts["vocab"] == 128256
+    assert facts["context_length"] == 131072
+    assert facts["tied_embeddings"] is False
+    assert facts["rms_eps"] == 1e-05
+    assert facts["rope_theta"] == 500000.0
+    # No layer_types/qk_norm/sliding declared -- nothing guessed for them.
+    assert "sliding_layers" not in facts
+    assert "qk_norm" not in facts
+    assert "recurrent_layers" not in facts
+
+
+def test_name_falls_back_to_spec_name_when_not_given():
+    spec = parse_architecture(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["name"] == spec.name
+
+
+def test_rope_theta_defaults_when_rope_present_without_explicit_theta():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    del config["rope_theta"]
+    config["rope_scaling"] = {"type": "linear", "factor": 2.0}
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["rope_theta"] == 10000.0
+
+
+def test_mqa_model_defaults_kv_heads_to_heads_when_absent():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    del config["num_key_value_heads"]
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["kv_heads"] == facts["heads"] == 32
+
+
+def test_head_dim_falls_back_to_hidden_over_heads_when_undeclared():
+    spec = parse_architecture(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG, "fixture")
+    assert spec.head_dim is None  # config never states head_dim explicitly
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["head_dim"] == 2048 // 32
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# qk_norm / partial rotary
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+
+
+def test_qk_norm_flag_is_read_through_either_spelling():
+    for key in ("qk_norm", "use_qk_norm"):
+        config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+        config[key] = True
+        spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+        facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+        assert facts["qk_norm"] is True
+
+
+def test_partial_rotary_factor_derives_rope_dims():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["head_dim"] = 256
+    config["partial_rotary_factor"] = 0.25
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["rope_dims"] == 64
+
+
+def test_full_rotary_factor_omits_rope_dims():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["partial_rotary_factor"] = 1.0
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert "rope_dims" not in facts
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# sliding_layers / recurrent_layers from layer_types
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+
+
+def test_layer_types_sliding_window_gives_explicit_per_layer_indices():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["layer_types"] = [
+        "sliding_attention",
+        "sliding_attention",
+        "full_attention",
+        "sliding_attention",
+    ]
+    config["num_hidden_layers"] = 4
+    config["sliding_window"] = 4096
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["sliding_layers"] == [0, 1, 3]
+    assert facts["sliding_window"] == 4096
+
+
+def test_layer_types_all_full_attention_reports_confident_empty_sliding_layers():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["layer_types"] = ["full_attention", "full_attention"]
+    config["num_hidden_layers"] = 2
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["sliding_layers"] == []
+
+
+def test_max_window_layers_fallback_when_layer_types_absent():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["num_hidden_layers"] = 10
+    config["use_sliding_window"] = True
+    config["max_window_layers"] = 6
+    config["sliding_window"] = 2048
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["sliding_layers"] == list(range(6))
+    assert facts["sliding_window"] == 2048
+
+
+def test_recurrent_layers_from_non_attention_layer_types():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["layer_types"] = [
+        "linear_attention",
+        "linear_attention",
+        "full_attention",
+        "linear_attention",
+    ]
+    config["num_hidden_layers"] = 4
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert facts["recurrent_layers"] == [0, 1, 3]
+    assert any("recurrent_layers inferred" in note for note in coverage_notes(spec))
+
+
+def test_sliding_only_layer_types_does_not_trigger_a_recurrent_layers_note():
+    # Regression: decoder_type == "Hybrid" is extract.py's own loose label for
+    # *any* layer_types list, including a pure sliding/full mix with no
+    # recurrent layers at all -- that must not spuriously ask for gdn by hand.
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["layer_types"] = ["sliding_attention", "full_attention"]
+    config["num_hidden_layers"] = 2
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    assert spec.decoder_type == "Hybrid"
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert "recurrent_layers" not in facts
+    assert not any("recurrent_layers" in note for note in coverage_notes(spec))
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# coverage_notes: MoE / MLA / no_rope_layers
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+
+
+def test_moe_model_gets_a_coverage_note():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["num_experts"] = 8
+    config["num_experts_per_tok"] = 2
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    assert spec.decoder_type == "Sparse MoE"
+    notes = coverage_notes(spec)
+    assert any("Sparse MoE" in note for note in notes)
+
+
+def test_mla_model_gets_a_coverage_note():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["kv_lora_rank"] = 512
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    assert spec.attention_type == "MLA"
+    notes = coverage_notes(spec)
+    assert any("Multi-head Latent Attention" in note for note in notes)
+
+
+def test_no_rope_layers_key_flags_a_manual_review_note_without_guessing():
+    config = dict(_DENSE_GQA_CONFIG)
+    config["no_rope_layers"] = [1, 1, 0, 1]
+    spec = parse_architecture(config, "fixture")
+    facts = build_loom_arch_facts(spec)
+    assert "nope_layers" not in facts
+    notes = coverage_notes(spec)
+    assert any("no_rope_layers" in note for note in notes)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# diff_against_existing
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+
+
+def test_diff_flags_a_value_mismatch():
+    derived = {"hidden": 2048, "heads": 32}
+    existing = {"hidden": 4096, "heads": 32}
+    lines = diff_against_existing(derived, existing)
+    assert len(lines) == 1
+    assert "hidden" in lines[0]
+
+
+def test_diff_flags_a_missing_key_as_an_addition():
+    derived = {"hidden": 2048, "qk_norm": True}
+    existing = {"hidden": 2048}
+    lines = diff_against_existing(derived, existing)
+    assert len(lines) == 1
+    assert "qk_norm" in lines[0]
+
+
+def test_diff_compares_lists_order_independently():
+    derived = {"sliding_layers": [0, 1, 3]}
+    existing = {"sliding_layers": [3, 1, 0]}
+    assert diff_against_existing(derived, existing) == []
+
+
+def test_diff_never_flags_a_field_tracelens_does_not_derive():
+    derived = {"hidden": 2048}
+    existing = {"hidden": 2048, "attn_gate": "fused_q", "rope_type": "neox"}
+    assert diff_against_existing(derived, existing) == []
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# CLI
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+
+
+def test_cli_end_to_end_writes_json(tmp_path, capsys):
+    output_path = tmp_path / "cfg.json"
+    exit_code = loom_port_cfg_cli.main(
+        [
+            str(FIXTURES / "custom_model"),
+            "--no-meta-shapes",
+            "--output",
+            str(output_path),
+        ]
+    )
+    assert exit_code == 0
+    captured = capsys.readouterr()
+    assert "Wrote Loom architecture facts" in captured.out
+    payload = json.loads(output_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    assert payload["hidden"] == 4096
+    assert payload["layers"] == 32
+    assert payload["kv_heads"] == 8
+    # custom_model is MLA + Sparse MoE -- both notes should surface on stderr.
+    assert "Multi-head Latent Attention" in captured.err
+    assert "Sparse MoE" in captured.err
+
+
+def test_cli_prints_json_to_stdout_by_default(capsys):
+    exit_code = loom_port_cfg_cli.main(
+        [str(FIXTURES / "custom_model"), "--no-meta-shapes"]
+    )
+    assert exit_code == 0
+    payload = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
+    assert payload["arch"] == "custom_mla_moe"
+
+
+def test_cli_requires_a_checkpoint():
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        loom_port_cfg_cli.main([])
+
+
+def test_cli_reports_an_architecture_load_failure_without_a_traceback(capsys):
+    exit_code = loom_port_cfg_cli.main(
+        ["/nonexistent/path/for/testing", "--no-meta-shapes"]
+    )
+    assert exit_code == 1
+    assert "Error loading architecture" in capsys.readouterr().err
+
+
+def test_cli_check_mode_reports_no_mismatches_against_its_own_output(tmp_path):
+    output_path = tmp_path / "cfg.json"
+    assert (
+        loom_port_cfg_cli.main(
+            [
+                str(FIXTURES / "custom_model"),
+                "--no-meta-shapes",
+                "--output",
+                str(output_path),
+            ]
+        )
+        == 0
+    )
+    exit_code = loom_port_cfg_cli.main(
+        [
+            str(FIXTURES / "custom_model"),
+            "--no-meta-shapes",
+            "--check",
+            str(output_path),
+        ]
+    )
+    assert exit_code == 0
+
+
+def test_cli_check_mode_flags_a_mismatch(tmp_path, capsys):
+    existing_path = tmp_path / "existing_cfg.json"
+    existing_path.write_text(json.dumps({"hidden": 1, "heads": 32}), encoding="utf-8")
+    exit_code = loom_port_cfg_cli.main(
+        [
+            str(FIXTURES / "custom_model"),
+            "--no-meta-shapes",
+            "--check",
+            str(existing_path),
+        ]
+    )
+    assert exit_code == 1
+    assert "hidden" in capsys.readouterr().out
